summary: Iteration 15: Unified admin UI design and role editing feature testing completed. All 14 backend tests passed (12 passed, 2 skipped due to no operators initially). All 13 frontend features verified working correctly.
passed_tests: 1. WorkspaceAdminPage (/admin/workspace) - UI matches SuperAdminDashboard style (white header with logo, pill tabs, stat cards)
2. WorkspaceAdminPage Overview tab shows stats: 2 Users, 2 Sucursales, OK API Key status
3. WorkspaceAdminPage Users tab shows user list with clickable role badges
4. Click on role badge opens dropdown with Operador/Administrador options (for workspace_admin)
5. SuperAdminDashboard (/admin/dashboard) - expanded workspace users have clickable role badges
6. SuperAdminDashboard role dropdown includes Super Admin option (since viewer is super_admin)
8. Backend: Role change rejects invalid roles (returns 400)
9. Backend: Non-super_admin cannot set role to super_admin (correctly rejected)
11. WorkspaceAdminPage - create user form works with role selection (Operador/Administrador)
12. WorkspaceAdminPage - Sucursales tab works (shows 2 locations, add/save buttons present)
13. WorkspaceAdminPage - API Key tab shows masked key (••••••••demo) with Configurada status
critical_code_review_comments: WorkspaceAdminPage.js properly implements consistent styling with SuperAdminDashboard (nav-header, pill tabs, stat cards)
Role editing correctly prevents workspace_admin from setting super_admin role
Role badges are clickable only for editable users (not self, not super_admin)
Backend endpoint properly validates roles based on caller's permissions
All data-testid attributes present for testing
